step1_analysis.circuit_type: RF Power Amplifier with VSWR Protection
step1_analysis.description: A silicon bipolar RF power amplifier featuring a feedback control system for load mismatch protection. The protection circuit (Q2, Q3) detects peak voltage at the output collector node and clamps it by varying the circuit gain to prevent breakdown during overvoltage conditions.

paper_reference.title: A VSWR-Protected Silicon Bipolar RF Power Amplifier With Soft-Slope Power Control

voltage_gain.description: Small-signal voltage gain at the operating frequency (1.8 GHz)

sky130_expected.calculation: Single stage CE amplifier gain ~ gm * Rload. With a 50 ohm load and typical gm, the gain of a single stage is around 10-20 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 80 dB reported in the paper likely refers to the entire multi-stage amplifier chain or control loop gain. A single RF stage will provide much less gain.

output_power.description: RF output power delivered to a 50-ohm load at 1.8 GHz

sky130_expected.calculation: Pout = Vpeak^2 / (2*R). For VDD=1.8V, max Vpeak ~ 1.5V. Pout = 1.5^2 / 100 = 22.5 mW = 13.5 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the 1.8V supply voltage in SKY130 compared to higher voltages (7V/16V) in the original paper.

efficiency.description: Collector efficiency (RF output power / DC input power)

sky130_expected.calculation: Class A/AB amplifiers typically achieve 30-50% efficiency depending on the bias point and voltage swing.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be similar to the paper's reported values, though slightly lower due to lower VDD and headroom constraints.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure AC voltage gain, output power, and efficiency of the RF PA at 1.8 GHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VSWR-Protected Silicon Bipolar RF Power Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Generic NPN model (used since standard SKY130 NPNs require specific subcircuit calls)
.model npn npn (bf=100 is=1e-16)

* DUT (Resistor values appended to make valid SPICE)
R1 N1 LABEL_NET_0 1k
R2 N3 LABEL_NET_1 1k
R3 RFout N3 1k
R4 N1 N3 1k
Q1 RFout RFin GND npn
Q2 RFout LABEL_NET_1 N1 npn
Q3 N1 LABEL_NET_0 RFin npn

* Biasing and Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9

* RF Choke and Load
Lchoke VDD RFout 100n
Cblock RFout OUT 10p
Rload OUT 0 50

* Input Signal
Vbias RFin_bias 0 0.85
Lbias RFin_bias RFin 100n
Cblock_in IN RFin 10p
Vin IN 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 0.5 1.8G)

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let dc_pwr = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print dc_pwr

  * AC Analysis for Gain
  ac dec 20 100M 10G
  let gain = vdb(out) - vdb(in)
  meas ac gain_18g find gain at=1.8G

  * Transient Analysis for Power and Efficiency
  tran 10p 10n
  meas tran vout_pk max v(out) from=5n to=10n
  meas tran vout_min min v(out) from=5n to=10n
  let vout_amp = (vout_pk - vout_min) / 2
  let pout_w = (vout_amp * vout_amp) / (2 * 50)
  let pout_dbm = 10 * log10(pout_w * 1000)
  print pout_dbm

  meas tran idc_avg avg i(VVDD) from=5n to=10n
  let pdc = -idc_avg * 1.8
  let eff = (pout_w / pdc) * 100
  print eff
  
  quit
.endc
.end
